sentences.en: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
sentences.zh: 如果我们那样对他太不好了，那将是不公平的。

sentences.en: I would rather die than do such an unfair thing.
sentences.zh: 我宁死也不愿做这种不公正的事情。

sentences.en: It is unfair to ask someone to be like you.
sentences.zh: 要求别人像你一样是不公平的。

senses.zh: 不公平的，不公正的，(商业上)不正当的
